tech_stack.style_system: Tailwind CSS / NativeWind or StyleSheet for React Native .js components

visual_identity.mood: Enchanting, personal, spiritual, premium, trustworthy, editorial newspaper-style prediction feel transformed into a sleek digital experience.

typography.file_type_note: This project uses .js files (not .tsx). Ensure all React Native components are styled for .js files.
typography.headline_font: Georgia / Serif display font (or Playfair / Cinemax Serif equivalent in Expo) for elegant editorial headers like 'ZODIAC', 'How Zodiac Works', and 'It's a good day to align your stars'. Never use Inter for main headings.
typography.body_font: System / Sans-Serif (SF Pro / Roboto) for high readability in body copy, labels, inputs, and form fields.

layout_and_screens.1_splash_screen: Shows hexagon Z logo with letter Z + ZODIAC wordmark over deep cosmic background with subtle star twinkle and a 3-second smooth scale/zoom animation before transitioning to Auth.
layout_and_screens.2_auth_screen: Mobile number input + OTP verification tabbed with Signup (Name, Mobile, DOB, Place of birth, optional Time of birth, optional Email). Smooth keyboard-avoiding container.
layout_and_screens.3_birth_details_form: Dedicated screen or step for collecting exact birth details (Date, Time, Location) with celestial picker UI to compute exact Zodiac sign & natal chart positions.
layout_and_screens.4_how_it_works_onboarding: 4-step story-style carousel or vertical tap-card flow based on HowItWorks.jpg reference. Tapping screen or waiting 3 seconds advances. Includes skip & step progress indicators.

5_home_screen.header: Left profile icon (opens My Account), Center 'ZODIAC' serif wordmark, Right notification bell with unread badge dot.
5_home_screen.hero_section: Greeting 'Hello, [Name]' in purple light font, bold headline 'It's a good day to align your stars', user zodiac sign name with glyph icon + 'Current Position'. Right side features glowing orbit/planet illustration with small floating zodiac glyphs and star sparkles.
5_home_screen.daily_predictions_card: 'My Daily Zodiac Predictions' card with current date string (e.g. 'Oct 24, 2026'). Contains 4 rows: Love (pink heart), Career (teal briefcase), Finance (gold dollar), Wellbeing (purple meditation/sun). Each with 1-line personalized prediction & chevron to expand.
5_home_screen.daily_remedy_challenge_card: Dark card with cosmic mountain/journey illustration, displaying today's positive remedy or spiritual challenge.
5_home_screen.habit_streak_section: 🔥 Daily Streak - 7 Days indicator. Rewarding visual design encouraging daily check-ins.
5_home_screen.subscription_lock_state: When trial ends, predictions & remedy cards exhibit a blurred glass overlay with 'Start Your Subscription' CTA leading to ₹99/month paywall.
5_home_screen.bottom_navigation: Fixed 3-item navigation bar: Left 'Ask Astrologer' (opens coming soon view), Center elevated circular gold/amber floating button with crown icon ('Unlock Premium' / Subscription trigger), Right 'Shop' (opens shop/merch placeholder).

layout_and_screens.6_prediction_detail_screen: Expanded detailed astrological breakdown for Love, Career, Finance, or Wellbeing with planetary position explanations, dosage of guidance, and shareable quote card.
layout_and_screens.7_paywall_subscription_screen: ₹99/month subscription offering 2 days free trial. Shows key benefits list: Full daily Love/Career/Finance/Wellbeing predictions, daily remedies & challenges, custom planetary transit updates.
layout_and_screens.8_notifications_panel: List of daily horoscope alerts, planetary shift updates, and streak reminders.
layout_and_screens.9_my_account_and_edit_profile: User profile with avatar, zodiac sign summary, birth chart info, subscription status, notification toggles, and edit birth details action.
layout_and_screens.10_ask_astrologer_coming_soon: Elegant placeholder previewing direct astrologer chat with option to join notification waitlist.
layout_and_screens.11_shop_coming_soon: Curated celestial products, gemstone recommendations, and astro-merchandise store placeholder.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards, and key information blocks MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='daily-prediction-love-card', data-testid='unlock-premium-button').
Header and navigation overlays MUST NOT use complete transparent background. Use solid deep cosmic background or glassmorphism with dark semi-transparent tint backdrop-blur.
Strictly follow React Native Expo .js (JavaScript) formatting standards for component exports and styling.
Maintain high APCA / WCAG text contrast on dark backgrounds: pure white text (#FFFFFF) for main headlines, soft light grey (#9CA3AF) for body copy.
Micro-interactions: Add active scale press effects (e.g. activeOpacity={0.8} or Animated.spring) on cards and buttons.
Ensure input forms handle React Native KeyboardAvoidingView safely for seamless birth date and mobile entry.
instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before writing implementation code.
Build clean React Native components inside the Expo Router directory structure with .js files.

Implement the complete user journey: Splash (3s animation) -> Auth / Birth Details -> How It Works (4 steps) -> Home Screen -> Prediction Details / Paywall / Notifications / Profile / Ask Astrologer / Shop.

Strictly adhere to the Home Screen reference image visual layout: hero greeting, planet orbit illustration, 4 sub-prediction rows (Love, Career, Finance, Wellbeing), remedies card, streak tracker, elevated gold bottom button.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for automated test reliability.
